Since (A^2)_ii=d, edge entries (A^2)_ij=c_ij and off-edge entries nonnegative, diagonal positivity exactly 1-s+(1+1/d)q>=0 and worst-edge condition exactly s>=(2-t/d)q. For noncomplete connected regular graph, t<=d-2, combine q<=(s/(2-t/d)) and q>=(s-1)/(1+1/d) for s>1 to get sharp s*=(2d-t)/(d-1-t). Equal stages x=y for 0<s<=4/(2-t/d), then q=s/(2-t/d) and positive roots for larger s, attain all totals. At s*, both constraints tight; q*=d/(d-1-t), discriminant (t^2+4d)/(d-1-t)^2>0 yields unique unordered positive stages and extremal stochastic P*=(A²-tA-dI)/(d(d-1-t)). On K_(d+1), h2=1/(d+1) projects onto constants regardless of h1, proving unbounded time. Independent exact rational identities verified for d,t=(2,0),(3,0),(4,1),(4,2),(6,2),(8,0); checked that provided verification program forms matrices correctly.
